channel.title: Project Planar Player's Guide
channel.description: Last 10 notes on Project Planar Player's Guide

item.title: 435 Themis
item.description: 435 · Themis Themis is the Archangel of Justice, and the other half of Archon, the Archdevil of Tyranny.

item.title: 433 Verita
item.description: 433 · Verita Verita is the Archangel of Truth, and the other half of Tiyanak, the Archdevil of Deceit. Verita is almost entirely transparent.

item.title: 441 Pyrrha
item.description: 441 · Pyrrha Pyrrha is the dragon lord of Fire. She rules from inside an enormous volcano. She is the largest of the five lords and moves the least.

item.title: 444 Charis
item.description: 444 · Charis Charis is the second dragon of Water, made by Vetur with the help of Grixt, the archfey of Rot. Charis is undead.

item.title: 243 Passing Through Tarkis
item.description: 243 · Passing Through Tarkis Reachable only from a patron page. If you got here another way, tell me.

item.title: 434 Pavlas
item.description: 434 · Pavlas Pavlas is the Archangel of Humility, and the other half of Lux, the Archdevil of Pride.

item.title: 445 Tenu
item.description: 445 · Tenu Tenu is the dragon lord of Earth. Tenu is stone and has been in the same mountain so long that it is hard to tell the dragon from the room.

item.title: 242 Standing in the Heavens
item.description: 242 · Standing in the Heavens Reachable only from a patron page. If you got here from somewhere else, tell me.

item.title: 449 Zaros
item.description: 449 · Zaros Zaros was the dragon lord of Air until the ascendant god Afthor killed him, drank his blood and took the realm, fifty years ago.

item.title: 450 Vari
item.description: 450 · Vari Vari was the second dragon of Air, made by Zaros alone, and the two ruled the realm together, which no other lord and second has done.
